summary.text: Doug Dern, an attorney and the chair of the Natural Law Party of Michigan, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan Attorney General to Eli Savit.
He appeared on the Bureau of Elections' general-election candidate listing and in Votebeat's ballot guide.

paragraphs.text: Dern earned an undergraduate degree from Oklahoma University in 1999 and a J.D. from Thomas Cooley Law School in 2002, and has worked as an attorney.
Dern received 0.3% of the vote to Eli Savit's 52.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
